paper_title: Revisiting Dark Photon Constraints from CMB Spectral Distortions
coupling_convention: epsilon (dark photon kinetic mixing, dimensionless), exactly as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 8
notes: Paper revisits COBE/FIRAS CMB spectral distortion constraints on photon->dark photon conversion (kinetic mixing eps vs m_dp) using CosmoTherm, including entropy extraction; limits are ~1.5x tighter than McDermott & Witte 2020 and extended to md~1e-3 eV via large-distortion treatment. No numerical table is provided; limits are shown in Fig. 8 over md in [1e-12, 1e-3] eV. Data points reconstructed from explicit text anchors: (i) md=1e-7 eV, eps=4e-8 stated as excluded at a few sigma by FIRAS; (ii) analytic relation Delta_rho/rho_dis = 0.5421*gamma_con*J_bb < 6e-5 (95% CL) with gamma_con ~ 9.91*(eps/1e-5)^2 (from the md=1e-4 eV, eps=1e-5 example), giving eps_limit ~ 3.3e-8 across the mu/y-era mass range; (iii) limit extends to md~1e-3 eV near the eps~3e-5 grid ceiling in the large-distortion regime. Points at md<1e-9 eV and md>1e-4 eV are rough estimates; treat with caution. Paper also gives PIXIE projections (~6e-10 at intermediate masses, eps=1e-9 at 1e-7 eV excluded at a few sigma) and an Neff bound eps<1.8e-6 for md<5e-3 eV, not included in data_points.
